identity.title: Observational Signatures of Planets in Protoplanetary Disks I. Gaps Opened by Single and Multiple Young Planets in Disks

paper_type_evidence.quote: we combine two-dimensional two fluid (gas + particle) hydrodynamical calculations with three-dimensional Monte Carlo Radiative Transfer simulations, and study the observational signatures of gaps opened by one or several planets

question.value: Are gaps opened by one or several planets in protoplanetary disks broadly consistent with observed gaps/cavities in transitional disks at NIR and mm wavelengths?

evidence.quote: aim at answering this basic question: are they broadly consistent with some observed gaps in disks?
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00015.SV.

what.value: ALMA image of the HL Tau disk used for qualitative comparison with model mm image

evidence.loc: 4.2 An HL-Tau-Like System with Multiple Separate Gaps and Rings
evidence.quote: A comparison between the model mm image and the observation of HL Tau is shown in Figure [\[fig:comparison\]](#fig:comparison).

what.value: Observed NIR gap contrasts for RX J1604.3-2130, HD 142527, SAO 206462, PDS 70

simulations_or_models_as_data.value: Five FARGO 2D gas+1 mm dust hydro models (1x0.2MJ, 1x1MJ, 4x1MJ, 4x2MJ, 3x0.2MJ) fed into Whitney MCRT code to make H-band and ALMA band 7 (870 um) model images

evidence.quote: In total we carry out five simulations.

what.value: Hydro model setups largely adopted from Zhu et al. 2011

evidence.quote: Hydrodynamical model setups are largely adopted from (cite: zhu11), and are briefly summarized here.

what.value: MCRT disk setup adopted from Dong et al. 2012 (cavity paper)

evidence.quote: The disk setup is largely adopted from (cite: dong12cavity).
using the FARGO code (cite: masset00) with a newly implemented dust fluid (cite: zhu12)

unstated_but_needed: Whitney MCRT code version and input parameter files
Hydro floor value for big-grain surface density

method.value: FARGO with dust fluid, planets on fixed circular orbits, no accretion, alpha=0.001, 256x256 cells, 1-500 AU

evidence.quote: The simulations have 256 grid cells in both radial (1-500 AU) and azimuthal ($2\pi$) directions.

key_parameters.value: 1 mm particles; initial dust-to-gas 0.9%; T = 221 (r/AU)^-1/2 K; 1 Msun star

evidence.quote: We further assume a radial temperature distribution $T = 221 (r/{\rm AU})^{-1/2}$ K

assumptions.value: Schmidt number Sc=1; Epstein drag; no dust feedback

evidence.quote: No feedback from the dust on the gas is considered since gas-to-dust mass ratio is always much larger than 1 in our simulations.

method.value: Map 2D densities to 3D with Gaussian vertical profiles and settling, run Whitney MCRT with 4 billion photon packages to get H-band and 870 um images

evidence.quote: All simulations are run with 4 billion photon packages.

key_parameters.value: Small grains Sigma_sg = 0.1% Sigma_g; big grains 0.9-1.1 mm

evidence.quote: We set $\Sigma_{\rm sg}=0.1\%~\Sigma_{\rm g}$
The source is assumed to be at a distance of 140 pc from earth.

method.value: Convolve with Gaussian PSF (0.04'' H band; 0.1'' ALMA B7; 0.035'' for 3x0.2MJ), measure gap edges at half peak and contrasts from azimuthal averages

evidence.quote: convolved images at ALMA band 7 are produced by convolving the raw images by a Gaussian kernel with a FWHM of $0.1\ensuremath{''}$

validation.value: Qualitative comparison of gap contrasts and sizes with published observations

evidence.quote: Nevertheless, our models show promising agreement with observations.
using the FARGO code (cite: masset00)

used_for.value: 3D Monte Carlo radiative transfer images and SEDs

evidence.quote: We carry out 3D MCRT simulations using the code developed by (cite: whitney13).
calculated using the routine developed by (cite: bohren83)

results_numeric.quantity: Big-grain gap density contrast, models with Mp>=1MJ

evidence.quote: $\gtrsim10^9$

results_numeric.quantity: H-band convolved gap contrast, Mp>=1MJ models

evidence.quote: At $H$ band, $\zeta_{\rm image,conv}$ are only around 3-6 for all models with $M_{\rm p}\geq1M_{\rm J}$

results_numeric.quantity: mm convolved gap contrast, Mp>=1MJ models

evidence.quote: comparing with $\sim100-1600$ at mm wavelengths
the gap opened by a one $M_{\rm J}$ planet at 30 AU is only $\sim$10 AU wide, while a $\sim$22 AU gap is opened by four 1 $M_{\rm J}$ planets

results_numeric.quantity: HL Tau-like model mm gap contrasts (inner to outer)

evidence.loc: 4.2 An HL-Tau-Like System with Multiple Separate Gaps and Rings
evidence.quote: are 1.5, 3.8, and 1.8 from the innermost to the outermost gaps

findings_qualitative.value: Planet-induced spiral arms are more apparent at NIR than at mm; inner-disk shadowing makes a circular gap appear off-center in inclined scattered-light images

evidence.quote: When viewed at a moderate inclination angle, a physically circular on-centered gap could appear to be off-centered from the star due to shadowing.

claims.hypothesis: Can a single low-mass planet produce a mm gap with no NIR gap?
claims.finding: Consistent with transitional disks missing a NIR cavity

evidence.quote: a single planet as small as 0.2 $M_{\rm J}$ can produce a deep gap at millimeter (mm) wavelengths and almost no features at near-infrared (NIR) wavelengths

claims.hypothesis: Do multiple planets open wide common gaps matching observed gap sizes and contrasts?
claims.experiment: 4-planet models compared to published NIR gap contrasts

evidence.quote: Nevertheless, our models show promising agreement with observations.

limitations_admitted.value: No instrumental effects/noise, no planet accretion or migration, no dust evolution; absolute intensities are only references

evidence.quote: absolute values of $\Sigma_{\rm sg}$ and $\Sigma_{\rm bg}$ and the resulting absolute intensities of the images should be taken as references only

referee_caveats_inferred: Comparison with ALMA is only qualitative; no synthetic visibilities
Results depend on assumed dust ratios and alpha

missing_for_reproduction: Hydro floor and exact initial conditions
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: No ALMA data processed; simulations only
reproducibility.score_reason: Simulation setup largely described but relies on inherited setups and external codes; ALMA data not analysed.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Theory paper; ALMA data only for qualitative comparison.
